sloka: तस्मिंस्तथा ब्रुवाणे तु राक्षसः प्रहसन्निव ।प्रत्युवाच नरश्रेष्ठं दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो ऽसि दुर्मते ।। ७.६८.१३ ॥
transliteration: tasmiṁstathā bruvāṇe tu rākṣasaḥ prahasanniva ।pratyuvāca naraśreṣṭhaṁ diṣṭyā prāpto 'si durmate ।। 7.68.13 ॥

translations.english: As he spoke thus, the demon, as if laughing, replied to the best of men, "Fortunately, O evil-minded one, you have arrived!"
